stem: Why does Addie compare the settlement home to a lantern in the paragraph?
instruction: Read paragraph 1 of the selection from The Boston Girl.

options.label: F
options.text: To exaggerate the judgmental attitudes of those who run the house

options.label: G
options.text: To indicate that the community surrounding the house takes its services for granted

options.label: H
options.text: To help the reader to visualize the beautiful architecture of the house

options.label: J
options.text: To symbolize the house as a comforting place in a poverty-stricken neighborhood

visual_elements: The settlement house was a four-story building that stood out from everything else in the neighborhood. It was new with yellow bricks instead of red. It had electricity in all the rooms so at night it lit up the street like a lantern.
